scope: Estimate remaining Stage 1 V7 provider-generation cost without making provider calls, opening references, or changing the frozen V7 semantic contract.

notes: Flex is priced at 50% of GPT-6 Sol Standard rates as verified on 2026-10-01.
Cache-write pricing is not additive: an input token uses the uncached-input, cached-input, or cache-write rate.
Reasoning tokens are included in output tokens and billed at the output-token rate.
No observed Stage 1 request approaches the >272K-input long-context threshold.

historicalProxy.source: Frozen V5 ordinals 2-50 usage profile retained by the V6 cost receipt, because V7 still reuses the same 50 frozen Structure Evidence v2 packets.

projectionForRemaining49.basis: Use exact historical V5 ordinals 2-50 input/output usage as the conservative central proxy; add the observed +394 input/cache-write-token V7 prompt delta per track from the same ordinal-1 packet; do not assume the V7 canary's much lower output usage generalizes.
projectionForRemaining49.maxOutputCapScenarioDefinition: All 49 remaining calls consume the projected input-side cost plus the full frozen 8192 output-token cap, with no retries.
limitations: The V7 canary is only one direct same-track token comparison, so its lower output usage is not used as the central estimate.
The per-track +394 prompt delta is extrapolated from ordinal 1; exact input tokenization can vary slightly across tracks.
This is a planning estimate, not spend authorization or an account billing guarantee.

userReportedBalanceContext.interpretation: On the reported balance and current pricing, the remaining49 V7 run appears funded even under the full-output-cap planning scenario, but execution remains blocked pending a separate explicit approval.

currentRecommendation.reason: Complete and validate all provider-free V7 remaining49 infrastructure first; only then request fresh explicit approval for the one-attempt-per-ordinal batch.
